answer: Make trust flow like a river delta, not a floodgate: a newcomer must earn standing through many independent channels, each job checked by a different veteran, so no single clique can certify a fake. Standing climbs terrace by terrace, each level unlocked only after a full season of verified work, and a glacier-slow release means reputation thaws gradually, never all at once. Flow meters cap each channel's grants per epoch, freezing routes that suddenly surge. Sybil farms must fund every channel, climb every terrace, and wait out the thaw for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
